items.event: Presidents Cup — Sunday singles at Medinah
items.line: International team led the U.S. 8.5-5.5 after Saturday's fourball, with foursomes still tightening things up. Sunday's 12 singles matches decide it all: the Americans are chasing a 10th straight Presidents Cup win, while International is chasing its first win since 2019.

items.event: Laver Cup — decisive Sunday at The O2, London
items.line: Team World leads Team Europe 5-3 after two days, but Sunday's matches are worth 3 points each (13 needed to win) — enough for either side to flip it in a session or two. Alcaraz and Zverev carry Europe's hopes against Fritz and de Minaur.
